Looking for LOCAL companies hiring remote/WFH or have remote/WFH as a disability accommodation.

Hi everyone. I have a disability and I have been trying to get full time salaried work for SIX YEARS. I have some passive income which is how I made it this far but it is not nearly enough. I have over 60k in credit card debt from paying for living expenses and it’s making me physically sick. I’m continuously at risk of losing my housing and I’ve had to beg and borrow. I am completely capable of working, but I need either a job that is remote/WFH, or I can get remote/WFH as a disability accommodation. I struggle with something called dissociative amnesia meaning some days it’s not safe for me to drive and I struggle with being physically around lots of other people.

My last job was as an accountant, but my schooling does not match and I do not have a CPA, I was trained on the job. I will take anything that is remote/possibly remote that pays reasonably and provides health insurance. I know companies like to hire local even if the work is remote, which is why I am looking for local recommendations. I have worked remotely in the past.

I have already met locally with the department of rehab and am in their system. They are excruciatingly slow and I have a feeling they are overloaded. I’m worried I will lose my housing before they can get me into a job.

I tried to count up how many applications I’ve put in, it’s over two thousand. I’ve interviewed for about 8 positions, all interviews went great, I asked for feedback and keep getting told there’s just lots of great applicants. I’m at my wits end.

Also if anyone is willing to give me a direct referral to an open job at your company I’m happy to meet for coffee or something and go over my resume so you know I’m not going to make you look bad by recommending me. I am a good candidate with lots of skills and stellar recommendations.

This is my previous company when they still had a US office: https://www.tellart.com

My degree is in fine art so I’ve had better luck with creative firms like design or architecture firms, but those jobs are few and far between.

I am happy to DM my LinkedIn profile.

Your Ultimate Guide to Scalp Micropigmentation Perth

If you’ve heard the term ‘scalp micropigmentation’ but aren’t quite sure what it is, you’re not alone. Think of it as a highly advanced, specialised cosmetic treatment that creates the illusion of real hair follicles on the scalp.

For anyone in Perth looking for a real solution to hair loss, SMP offers a way to either replicate the look of a sharp, freshly shaved buzz cut or to add the appearance of thickness to thinning hair. It’s an art form, really—a non-surgical way to bring back your confidence with results that look incredibly natural and are built to last.

# What Exactly Is Scalp Micropigmentation?



The best way to picture scalp micropigmentation is to imagine an artist using a technique called pointillism, where a full picture is built up from thousands of tiny, individual dots. That’s the heart of SMP. It’s definitely not a standard tattoo; it’s a highly refined procedure designed specifically for the scalp to create a powerful, realistic illusion of hair.

The process involves carefully depositing thousands of micro-dots of pigment into the top layer of the scalp. Each tiny dot is placed to mimic a single hair follicle. When layered together, these dots create the convincing appearance of a full head of hair. Unlike traditional tattoos, which go deeper and use different inks, SMP uses custom equipment and pigments designed to hold their colour and not fade into blues or greens over time.

# The Art and Science Behind SMP

A truly great **scalp micropigmentation Perth** treatment is a perfect marriage of artistic talent and technical skill. To get a result that’s completely undetectable, a skilled practitioner has to master several key elements.

* **Pigment Matching:** The first step is always choosing and often custom-blending pigment shades to perfectly match your existing hair and complement your skin tone.
* **Follicle Replication:** It’s not just about placing dots. An expert will vary the size, angle, and depth of each impression to recreate the subtle, three-dimensional look of real hair.
* **Hairline Design:** This is where the artistry truly shines. A natural, soft, and age-appropriate hairline that fits your facial structure is crucial. A harsh, fake-looking hairline is the biggest giveaway of a poor-quality job.

This detailed approach is what separates a fantastic result from a bad one. The goal is never a flat, "painted-on" look, but a textured, realistic buzz-cut or a subtle boost in density that blends seamlessly.

>

# Setting Expectations for Your Transformation

It's important to know that SMP is a journey, not a one-and-done appointment. Achieving the most authentic look typically takes **2-4 sessions**, spaced out to let the pigment settle and the skin heal. This layering method allows the practitioner to gradually build density and colour, making small adjustments along the way to ensure the final result looks perfect.

SMP is a direct answer to the visual problem of hair loss. Whether it's male pattern baldness, alopecia, or camouflaging scars from a transplant surgery, it provides a reliable and impressive fix.

To get a complete picture of the process, you can learn more about [what is scalp micropigmentation](https://www.mytransformation.com.au/blogs/news/what-is-scalp-micropigmentation) in our detailed guide. Ultimately, this treatment is about giving you a practical, long-term solution that lets you step out into the world feeling like yourself again.

# Is SMP the Right Solution for Your Hair Loss?

Scalp micropigmentation is a brilliant tool in the fight against hair loss, but it’s certainly not a one-size-fits-all fix. Figuring out if it’s the right path for you really comes down to your specific type of hair loss, your lifestyle, and what you’re hoping to achieve.

Especially here in Perth, with our active, sunny way of life, SMP offers a seriously tough and permanent solution that won’t sweat off at the beach or demand constant upkeep. Let's dig into the real-world situations where it truly makes a difference.

# Men with Male Pattern Baldness

For blokes dealing with male pattern baldness, SMP is an absolute game-changer. It doesn’t matter if you’re just noticing your hairline starting to creep back or you’re further down the track—this treatment has a smart solution.

* **Receding Hairlines:** If your hairline is on the retreat, SMP can skilfully redraw and bring it forward, framing your face with a sharp, clean-cut look that appears totally natural.
* **Crown Thinning:** That thinning patch at the crown is one of the most common signs of hair loss. We can add the illusion of density by carefully placing pigment between your existing hair, which makes the whole area look much thicker.
* **Advanced Baldness:** For guys with more extensive hair loss (often measured on the Norwood Scale), SMP creates the look of a sharp, stylish buzz cut. It’s a hugely popular choice for men who want to own their look with a low-maintenance, confident style.

It’s about ditching the worry over combovers or always reaching for a hat and just getting on with your life.

# Women with Diffuse Thinning

Women’s hair loss often looks a bit different. It’s usually a general, diffuse thinning all over the scalp rather than a receding hairline. SMP offers a subtle but incredibly powerful way to bring back that look of fullness.

Instead of creating a shaved-head look, the practitioner meticulously applies pigment between the existing hairs. This shades the scalp, which cleverly reduces the contrast between your hair and your skin. The immediate result? Your hair looks denser and thicker. It's a fantastic alternative to messy hair fibres or uncomfortable hair toppers.

We're seeing a massive surge in demand for this service from women across Western Australia. In fact, projections show the female market is growing so fast it could make up a **58% share** of all initial sessions by 2026. Here at My Transformation, Michael has honed his skills in creating these subtle density treatments that work beautifully with feminine hairstyles to deliver natural-looking volume.

# Camouflaging Scars and Imperfections

Scars on the scalp can be a real source of self-consciousness, whether they're from an accident, a surgery, or even an old FUE/FUT hair transplant. SMP is exceptionally good at hiding them.

>

For many clients, this is truly life-changing. It restores a smooth look and erases what can be a constant, unwanted reminder of a past procedure or injury. If you're curious about other ways SMP can help, our guide on [who can benefit from hair tattoos](https://www.mytransformation.com.au/blogs/news/who-can-benefit-from-hair-tattoos) dives into more examples.

# Enhancing Beard Density

And it’s not just for your head! Micropigmentation can also be used to help guys struggling with a patchy or thin beard. The principle is exactly the same: tiny pigment deposits are placed to look like individual hair follicles, filling in sparse areas to create a stronger, more defined beard line.

At the end of the day, if you’re searching for a long-term, low-maintenance way to tackle the visual side of hair loss, SMP is one of the most effective solutions you’ll find in Perth. It gets straight to the point by restoring the look of fullness, whether you want to rock a sharp buzz cut, add density to longer hair, or finally hide that old scar.

# Your SMP Journey: From First Chat to Final Result

Taking that first step to tackle your hair loss can feel like a massive decision, but knowing exactly what’s involved makes all the difference. We’re all about transparency here. You deserve to know what to expect from beginning to end, so we’ve laid out the entire journey at My Transformation—from our initial chat to your incredible new look.

Think of this as your roadmap. It’s a step-by-step guide so there are no surprises, just a clear, professionally managed path to getting your confidence back. Understanding what makes for a smooth and positive journey is key. It's why we focus on creating a supportive and informative [omnichannel customer experience](https://silverspoonagency.com/what-is-omnichannel-customer-experience/) at every single stage.

The chart below gives you a bird's-eye view of the process, whether you're a man, a woman, or looking to camouflage scarring.



As you can see, the core treatment is consistent and structured, but it's always tailored to your specific needs to ensure we get the best possible outcome for you.

# Step 1: The No-Obligation Consultation

Everything starts with a free, no-pressure chat with Michael. This first meeting is all about you. It’s your chance to fire away with any questions you have, and it’s our chance to get to know your story, understand your hair loss, and figure out what you want to achieve.

We’ll talk about your goals and then work together to design your ideal hairline. This isn't a one-size-fits-all thing; it's a genuine collaboration. Michael brings his artistic eye and technical skill to map out a soft, natural-looking hairline that actually suits your face shape, age, and personal style. You’ll walk out of this session with a crystal-clear vision of the plan.

# Step 2: The Treatment Sessions

This is where the real magic happens. Your SMP treatment is carefully broken down into **2 to 4 appointments**, with each session lasting a few hours. We build the look up gradually over time—this is absolutely crucial for achieving a result that looks real, not rushed.

* **Session 1:** We lay the foundation. This first pass establishes the shape of your new hairline and applies a light, scattered layer of pigment across the entire treatment area. Think of it as creating the perfect canvas to build upon.
* **Session 2:** After about a week of healing, you'll come back in for the second layer. This is where we start adding real density and texture, often using slightly different pigment shades to create a 3D effect that mimics the look of individual hair follicles.
* **Session 3 (and 4):** These final appointments are all about the details. We’ll perfect the blend into your existing hair, fill in any spots that need a touch more density, and make tiny adjustments to ensure the result is completely seamless and undetectable.

>

# Step 3: Aftercare and Looking After Your Look

Once your final session is done, keeping your new look in top shape is surprisingly simple. We’ll give you a straightforward aftercare plan to make sure your SMP heals perfectly and stays looking sharp for years, especially with our strong Perth sun.

* **The First Few Days:** For the initial healing period, you’ll need to avoid washing your scalp, heavy sweating, and direct sun. This gives the pigment the best chance to settle in and heal flawlessly.
* **Long-Term Care:** Your number one rule from here on out is sun protection. A good, high-SPF sunscreen applied to your scalp every day is the best thing you can do to protect the pigment from fading and keep the colour looking fresh.

Follow these simple rules, and your investment will look fantastic for **4-6 years** before you might need a small touch-up.

Want to dive a bit deeper into how it all works? Check out our article on [what's the process of getting a hair tattoo](https://www.mytransformation.com.au/blogs/news/whats-the-process-of-getting-a-hair-tattoo). Our entire process is designed to be clear, comfortable, and ultimately, a game-changer for our clients.

# Understanding the Cost of SMP in Perth



When you're looking into any kind of hair loss solution, the first question on your mind is usually, "What's this going to cost me?" It's a fair question, and the answer with scalp micropigmentation is one of the best parts of the story.

Think of SMP not as an ongoing bill, but as a one-off investment in yourself. Unlike other treatments that keep you paying year after year, SMP gives you a permanent result for a single, upfront cost.

Of course, there’s no simple price tag. Your treatment is quoted specifically for you, based on what you need to get a flawless, undetectable result.

# What Determines the Price of Your SMP

The biggest factor influencing the cost is the extent of your hair loss. We often use the Norwood Scale to get a clear picture of male pattern baldness, which helps us map out the exact area needing treatment. A perfect, seamless blend is always the goal.

Here’s a quick breakdown of what goes into your personal quote:

* **Area of Coverage:** Are we rebuilding a receding hairline, filling in a thinning crown, or creating a full buzz-cut look across the entire scalp? A small touch-up will naturally cost less than an extensive treatment.
* **Desired Density:** The final look you're after matters. A soft, subtle fill to add some depth is different from creating the look of a thick, dense head of hair, which requires more impressions and more time in the chair.
* **Scar Camouflage:** Working with scar tissue—often from old hair transplants—is a specialised skill. It requires a different technique and extra care to get it right, which can be reflected in the price.

>

# Realistic Price Ranges for SMP in Perth

So, what can you actually expect to pay? Here in Perth, SMP offers incredible value. At My Transformation, our pricing is often below the national average, but our results are absolutely world-class.

For a smaller job, like touching up a hairline, you might be looking at **$500 to $1,200**. For more common scenarios like filling in a thinning crown, the cost is typically around **$1,500 to $2,500**. For those who need full coverage for a complete buzz-cut look, the investment is usually **$3,000+**.

The best part? The pigments we use are designed to last for **4-8 years**. When you eventually need a touch-up, it’s a quick session that usually costs only about **20%** of your original treatment. This longevity is what makes the return on investment so powerful.

# Perth Hair Loss Solution Cost Comparison (Estimated)

This is where you really see the financial logic behind SMP. When you stack it up against the endless costs of other popular treatments, the value is undeniable. We've put together a quick comparison to show what the long-term journey looks like for different hair loss solutions available right here in Perth.

|FUE Hair Transplant|$8,000 - $20,000+|$600 - $1,200 (for meds)|$11,000 - $26,000+|

As the numbers show, things like hair systems and medications lock you into a cycle of constant spending. Hair transplants have a huge upfront cost and often require you to *still* pay for medication to maintain what you have. In contrast, SMP is a single investment that frees you from all that. You can find a deeper analysis in our complete guide on the [cost of scalp micropigmentation](https://www.mytransformation.com.au/blogs/news/cost-of-scalp-micropigmentation).

Ultimately, choosing **scalp micropigmentation in Perth** isn't just a decision about your appearance—it’s a smart financial move. You get a permanent, hassle-free solution that lets you stop worrying about hair loss and start living with complete confidence.

# Why Trust My Transformation for Your SMP



Choosing the right person for your scalp micropigmentation is the single most important decision you'll make in this process. This isn’t just a cosmetic service; it’s a detailed craft that demands an artistic eye, technical precision, and a genuine understanding of what makes an SMP treatment look completely natural. In Perth, your choice of artist will define your result for years to come.

At My Transformation, we get the weight of this decision. Our entire approach is built on a bedrock of trust, expertise, and a personal commitment to every single client who walks through our doors. We’re not a high-volume, churn-and-burn clinic. We're a dedicated studio, focused entirely on delivering world-class SMP results.

# The Specialist Advantage

When it comes to your scalp, a specialist is non-negotiable. While a general tattoo artist is incredibly skilled in their own right, SMP is a completely different discipline. It uses specialised needles, unique pigments engineered not to discolour, and a delicate touch that replicates the subtle look of real hair follicles.

This is where Michael’s focused expertise truly shines. His entire practice is dedicated to the art of scalp micropigmentation. This singular focus means he has mastered all the nuances that create a hyper-realistic result—everything from designing a natural hairline to flawlessly blending pigment with your unique skin tone. This level of specialisation is crucial, especially in Perth, where our strong sun can quickly expose poor-quality work.

>

Choosing a specialist dramatically lowers your risk of a bad outcome. Nationally, androgenetic alopecia affects over **50% of Australian men** by age 50, which has created a massive demand for SMP. The worrying part? Studies show a staggering **90% of bad SMP results** come from non-specialist salons, often leading to costly and emotionally draining correction work.

# Our Commitment to Quality and Safety

Your health and the quality of your result are our top priorities. Here at My Transformation, we make zero compromises on the tools and materials we use to achieve the best **scalp micropigmentation Perth** has to offer.

* **Premium Pigments:** We exclusively use the highest-quality, stable pigments formulated specifically for SMP. This is your guarantee that the treatment will hold its natural colour and won't fade to blue or green—a common and unfortunate issue with standard tattoo inks.
* **Leading-Edge Equipment:** Our studio is fitted out with the most advanced SMP machines and single-use needles. This allows for unmatched precision, ensuring each micro-dot is perfectly sized and placed for a truly realistic finish.
* **Immaculate Hygiene:** We operate in a meticulously sterile environment that not only meets but exceeds all health and safety standards. Every client can feel completely secure and comfortable from the moment they arrive.

When you're investing in a personal treatment like this, knowing how reputable businesses operate is key. For those interested, you can find valuable [insights for health and beauty businesses](https://rocketreview.co.nz/industries/health-beauty) to understand what sets the best clinics apart.

# Results That Speak for Themselves

Ultimately, the proof is in the results. Our gallery of before-and-after photos showcases the life-changing work we do day in and day out. You’ll see natural-looking hairlines, flawlessly blended density, and camouflaged scars that have given our clients a renewed sense of self.

Each transformation is a testament to Michael’s personal dedication. He works one-on-one with every client, taking the time to listen to their story and collaborate on a final look that exceeds their expectations. It’s this personal touch that truly sets My Transformation apart.

We invite you to see why we are considered Perth's premier SMP clinic. Discover more about our approach and see the transformations for yourself by reading about [the My Transformation SMP Clinic in Perth](https://www.mytransformation.com.au/blogs/news/my-transformation-smp-clinic-perth). We're confident that our commitment to artistry, safety, and client satisfaction makes us the right choice for your journey.

# Your SMP Questions Answered

Even after seeing the results for yourself, it’s completely normal to have a few more questions pop up. Deciding to go ahead with scalp micropigmentation is a big step, and you deserve to have all the facts before you commit. We believe in being totally transparent, so we’ve put together some straight answers to the most common questions we get from our clients here in Perth.

Think of this as your final checklist to clear up any lingering doubts. We’ll cover everything from what the treatment actually feels like to how it holds up under the intense Western Australian sun. Our goal is to make sure you walk into your first session feeling 100% confident and informed.

# Does Scalp Micropigmentation Hurt?

This is usually the first thing people ask, and the answer is probably better than you think. The vast majority of our clients describe the sensation as a light, consistent prickling, not a sharp pain. If you had to put it on a discomfort scale from 1 to 10, most people land somewhere between a **2 and a 4**.

It's really important to understand that this isn't like getting a regular tattoo. The needles we use are incredibly fine, and we’re only working on the very top layers of the skin, which makes the whole experience much less intense.

Michael is a pro at creating a calm, relaxed atmosphere and will check in with you constantly to make sure you’re doing okay. We can take breaks whenever you need one, so you can rest assured the session will be as comfortable as possible.

# How Long Does SMP Last in the Perth Sun?

Your new look is designed to go the distance. A quality SMP treatment will generally look its best for **4 to 6 years** before you might consider a simple touch-up session to restore its original vibrancy. That kind of longevity is a huge plus compared to other hair loss solutions.

Of course, living in Perth means we have to be smart about the sun. There's no getting around it—the powerful UV rays we get here are the number one thing that can cause any pigment to fade over time, whether it's the paint on your car or the pigment in your skin.

>

Honestly, this one simple step is the key to making sure your scalp micropigmentation stays looking fresh and completely natural for as long as possible.

# Will My SMP Result Look Natural?

Absolutely—and this is where the artist's skill truly makes or breaks the result. The whole point of **scalp micropigmentation in Perth** is to create a look so realistic that it’s completely undetectable. A natural-looking result isn't just a goal; it's the standard we hold ourselves to at My Transformation.

Getting that hyper-realistic finish comes down to a few critical details that separate an expert artist from an average one.

* **Multi-Tonal Pigments:** We never just use a single, flat shade of black. Michael carefully blends multiple pigment shades to create a 3D effect that mimics the subtle colour variations you’d see in real hair follicles.
* **Soft, Age-Appropriate Hairlines:** A harsh, super-sharp hairline is a dead giveaway of a bad SMP job. We specialise in designing soft, slightly feathered hairlines that are perfectly suited to your age and facial structure, ensuring it looks right on you today and ten years from now.
* **Varied Density and Size:** Real hair doesn't grow in a perfect grid. A true artist meticulously varies the size, angle, and depth of each tiny dot to replicate the beautifully random pattern of a genuine head of hair.

The focus is always on creating a look that blends seamlessly with any existing hair, giving you a subtle yet powerful boost. It’s an art form dedicated to fooling the eye.

# Can I Grow My Hair Out After Getting SMP?

Yes, you can. This is a common point of confusion, but the answer is simple. Scalp micropigmentation is a cosmetic treatment that happens on the surface of your skin and has absolutely no effect on your hair's natural ability to grow.

The pigment is placed in the upper dermis, while your hair follicles sit much deeper. This means the treatment never interferes with or damages the follicles. Your hair will keep growing exactly as it did before you came to see us.

In fact, for clients with thinning hair rather than total baldness, this is the whole point. The SMP creates a permanent shadow on the scalp, effectively reducing the contrast between your hair and your skin. This creates a powerful illusion of density and fullness that works with your existing hair. You can keep your hair at whatever length you like, and the SMP will just make what you have look thicker.

Are you ready to stop worrying about hair loss and start your journey towards renewed confidence? At **My Transformation**, we’re here to guide you every step of the way.
